fusions.name: Carve the Catch
fusions.desc: A carving cut that deals 9 damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Passed Platter
fusions.desc: Gaffs and carves every enemy within 3 tiles for 28 damage, healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hung to Share
fusions.desc: Hangs the day's catch where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Full Rail
fusions.desc: Every kill you make hangs a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
